items.title: Melbourne woman suffers acute liver failure after using knock-off drug
items.description: Megan Hancocks bought a drug labelled as the peptide compound retatrutide in cash from a beautician. Within a week of her second dose, she was in acute liver failure.

items.title: Steve Irwin 'wouldn't have wanted this': Australia Zoo calls police on traditional owner
items.description: Traditional owner Alwyn Lyall says he felt "extremely upset and humiliated" when police asked him to leave Australia Zoo, where he was trying to see a crocodile he says was "wrongfully arrested" and taken from the wild.

items.title: Could the 'bliss' trade set millions up for a comfortable retirement?

items.title: A diabolical Iran deal reveals the Trump administration's delusions
items.description: Just as Netanyahu's claims to be able to influence Trump have now become a burden to him, Trump's limited capacity to influence Netanyahu spells just as much trouble for peace in the Middle East.

items.title: Bird flu could be catastrophic for nation's vulnerable species, experts warn
items.description: The black swan, the Tasmanian devil and Australian sea lions are among the species at risk if a deadly strain of avian influenza takes hold in Australia, experts are warning.

items.title: Twin brothers born deaf hear their mum's voice for first time after epic surgery
items.description: An Australian-first eight hour surgical feat had one main purpose — for Artie and Jack to hear their mum's voice at the same time.

items.title: Live: Panthers start hot against Titans despite missing Origin stars

items.title: Why this Paraguay star was red-carded for covering his mouth

items.title: 'Everything's just so wrong': Inside the country town that turned to One Nation

items.title: Watchdog considers claims of 'over-the-top policing' at LGBTQIA+ clubs
items.description: Allegations of police aggression and intimidation during a drug operation at LGBTQIA+ venues across Sydney's Oxford Street will be considered by the law enforcement watchdog.

items.title: One dead after huge fire at Dominican beach resort

items.title: Transatlantic slave trade gravest crime against humanity, Juneteenth marks its end

items.title: Beetlejuice the Musical's Australian run ends early
items.description: Beetlejuice the Musical is calling curtains early on its Australian run, citing high operational costs.

items.title: Why these retirees won't give up the 3:30am starts and 14-hour shifts

items.title: If you didn't do it at 40, do it at 60
items.description: For some women, the act of asking, "what might still be possible" — of refusing to accept that the most meaningful chapters are already behind them — might be its own kind of resistance.

items.title: First case of deadly H5 bird flu confirmed in Australia
items.description: The virus, found in a migratory bird in Esperance, raises concerns for the poultry industry despite Australia having spent years preparing for such a biosecurity breach.

items.title: This warming apple and miso pudding will have you back for seconds

items.title: What does it mean for a nation to be a 'monoculture'?

items.title: No bail for brothers accused of wreaking havoc after Newcastle riot

items.title: Family of medical student who survived remote crash advocates for rescue flights
